summary: The change implements Iterator.prototype.flatMap in the single in-scope file, following the spec steps in order. Step 2 (TypeError on non-object) and step 4 (IsCallable check, then IteratorClose with the TypeError) come before GetIteratorDirect in step 5. The closure covers the outer IteratorStepValue, the mapper call with IfAbruptCloseIterator, the reject-primitives GetIteratorFlattenable (Object check, @@iterator GetMethod, Call, Object check, GetIteratorDirect), and the inner loop. Inner-next errors close the outer iterator, as the spec requires. The counter increments once per exhausted inner iterator and saturates at 2^53. The on_return path closes the inner iterator, then the outer one, with the spec's ordering. The 2 remaining failures are honest not-implemented errors from StringIteratorPrototype.next, which is outside this ticket. No test-specific branches, no swallowed errors, and no made-up values were found.
notes_for_next_attempt: Nothing blocking. Checks for the architect when landing: (1) get_iterator_flattenable_reject_primitives is a local copy of GetIteratorFlattenable. If kahvi_core::ops already exposes GetIteratorFlattenable, switch to it. If it does not, and Iterator.from/concat will need it, move it into ops as the ticket asks and say so in the report. (3) The strings-are-not-flattened failures depend on StringIteratorPrototype.next, which is a separate ticket.
